name: InterContinental Resort Hua Hin
insider_take: This beachfront sanctuary sits where Thai royalty once chose to escape Bangkok's heat, maintaining that regal elegance with modern luxury.
whats_special: The resort occupies a pristine stretch of Hua Hin Beach, famous for being Thailand's first beach resort destination since the 1920s. The property features traditional Thai architecture with contemporary design, and you're just minutes from the historic Hua Hin Railway Station - one of the most beautiful train stations in Thailand with its distinctive royal waiting room built for King Rama VII.
pro_tip: Visit the nearby Hua Hin Night Market for authentic street food, then catch the sunrise from the hotel's beachfront - the east-facing coastline offers spectacular dawn views over the Gulf of Thailand.
dont_miss: Take a horse ride along the beach at sunset (Hua Hin means "stone head" and is famous for beach horseback riding), explore the colorful Cicada Weekend Market for local arts and crafts, and visit the summer palace of Klai Kangwon - still used by the Thai Royal Family today.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on Hua Hin's pristine coastline
Multiple world-class dining venues with international and Thai cuisine
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities with traditional Thai treatments
Elegant resort architecture blending modern comfort with Thai design
cons: Large resort layout may require walking distances between facilities
